LINCOLN, Neb. — Lincoln police have released additional information about a fatal shooting Tuesday evening that claimed the life of a 19-year-old woman identified as Brianna.

Authorities have identified 37-year-old Tyler Benzel as the suspect in the shooting. According to Lancaster County Jail records, Benzel has been charged with first-degree murder in connection with the death.

According to Lincoln police, the incident began with a verbal and physical altercation involving Benzel’s wife, Brianna and other individuals.

Investigators said they believe the confrontation was initiated by Benzel’s wife. Police said Benzel later left his residence and approached the group.

Authorities allege that Benzel told the individuals to leave and made verbal threats before raising a firearm and firing at the group. Police said the confrontation and shooting took place away from Benzel’s property.

Officers arrived at the scene within moments and found Brianna suffering from a single gunshot wound.

Officers immediately began providing life-saving medical treatment at the scene. Brianna was subsequently transported to a local hospital, where she later died from her injuries.

Police recovered a 9mm handgun at the scene. However, investigators said forensic testing is still required to determine whether the recovered firearm was the weapon used in the shooting.

Authorities said they are not currently aware of any other weapons being involved in the incident.

Police said Benzel was cooperative when officers arrived at the scene. Authorities also said Benzel and his wife did not know Brianna or the other individuals involved before the altercation.

Advertisement

Benzel’s wife has not been arrested or charged in connection with the shooting at this time.

The investigation remains active as detectives continue gathering evidence, including forensic testing of the recovered firearm.

Authorities have not released additional information about the circumstances surrounding the shooting.

Benzel is presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in court.

22-year-old Zirovick Depina killed after shooting at house party in Taunton, Massachusetts

Published

2 weeks ago

on

September 6, 2026

By

Channel2 NOW Staff
Getting your Trinity Audio player ready...

TAUNTON, Mass. — One person was killed and seven others were injured in an overnight shooting at a house party in Taunton, Massachusetts, authorities said.

The shooting happened at approximately 12:35 a.m. Sunday at a residence in the 261 Weir Street area. Taunton police officers responded after receiving multiple 911 calls reporting gunshots.

When officers arrived, they found several people suffering from gunshot wounds. Investigators were also informed that additional victims had already been transported to area hospitals for medical treatment.

Authorities ultimately identified eight shooting victims, all of whom were reportedly in their early 20s.

One of the victims, 22-year-old Zirovick Depina of Brockton, was pronounced dead early Sunday morning, according to the Bristol County District Attorney’s Office.

Of the seven surviving victims, one remains in serious but stable condition, while the others suffered injuries that were considered non-life-threatening. Their identities have not been publicly released.

The shooting occurred during a gathering at the residence. Images from the scene showed a tent and tables in the yard, along with white balloons and what appeared to be a photo backdrop near a garage.

A neighbor told authorities that large gatherings and loud parties had reportedly been common at the residence.

The home is located about a mile from the Taunton Police Department headquarters. The neighbor expressed concern about the shooting occurring in the area, particularly given the late-night activity.

The investigation is being conducted by Taunton Police, Massachusetts State Police detectives assigned to the Bristol County District Attorney’s Office, and other investigative units. Detectives are working to determine what led to the gunfire and identify those responsible.

Advertisement

Anyone with information about the shooting is urged to contact Taunton police or investigators with the Bristol County District Attorney’s Office.

The investigation remains active and ongoing, and additional information is expected as authorities continue gathering evidence and interviewing witnesses.
